claims.claim: Qwen3.5-4B already contains a native vision encoder, so a second heavy semantic visual stack requires positive differential evidence rather than architectural default.
Native Qwen representation reuse is physically plausible, but familiarity/open-set quality remains an empirical question.
The likely minimal target is Retina as temporal/provenance/control fabric plus one native Qwen deep vision core plus tiny adaptive readout.
Text labels may become useful multimodal prototype anchors for user-specific visual concepts, but sensor evidence must remain separate and false-familiarity must be measured.
Visual-change control should become hierarchical: deterministic pixel change -> feature semantic delta -> optional language-semantic decode -> GWT only if globally useful.

dense_fusion_result: QNDRF direction strengthened but split into separable representation, calibration, temporal-control, semantic-decode and end-to-end action hypotheses. No architecture promotion without matched executable evidence.
